show: Stepping on Toes with Danielle Fishel and Val Chmerkovskiy
titel: ​SOT: Brought to You by Nutella (DWTS: The Next Pro 108)

einzeiler: Recapping the finale of Dancing with the Stars: The Next Pro and crowning the winner.
kurzfassung: The hosts break down the grand finale of Dancing with the Stars: The Next Pro, covering the finalists' customized style routines and high-pressure celebrity freestyle dances. They discuss the unique challenges of preparing complex choreography in just a few days alongside all-star partners like Adam Rippon, Neve Schulman, and Charli D'Amelio. Finally, they react to the emotional results and celebrate Adele taking home the ultimate title.
stichpunkte: The inaugural season finale of Dancing with the Stars: The Next Pro takes place in front of a live studio audience.
Finalists Adele, AJ, and Selena perform two routines: a favorite style chosen at the start of the season and a celebrity-paired freestyle.
Celebrity partners Adam Rippon, Neve Schulman, and Charli D'Amelio join the finalists with only three days of rehearsal time.
Selena delivers a clean and fun jive alongside Adam Rippon, earning high praise from the judges for her star quality.
AJ and Charli D'Amelio perform a smooth Viennese waltz and a content-heavy freestyle that showcases his technical abilities.
Adele and Neve overcome severe jet lag to perform an energetic samba and a fiery Paso Doble with pyrotechnics.
Contestants share emotional backstories during a pre-finale dinner, reflecting on personal sacrifices and career-defining moments.
Adele is crowned the winner of the competition, securing her spot as a professional dancer on the main show.

clips.hook: Showcasing international ballroom Latin dance at the highest competitive level.
clips.text: The speakers express deep admiration for a competitor who genuinely represents authentic, world-class competitive ballroom dancing rather than minor regional titles.

clips.hook: Three days of rehearsal time for a live finale is simply wild.
clips.text: The hosts express disbelief and label it irresponsible that the contestants and their celebrity partners were given only a few days to prepare multiple finale dances.

clips.hook: A performance that brings pure joy and enthusiastic applause.
clips.text: The speaker describes a wildly entertaining routine that completely won them over, prompting them to clap out loud despite it not being traditional dance perfection.

clips.hook: Three months of hard work riding on a single minute and a half.
clips.text: The discussion turns to the intense pressure of the freestyle round, where months of prior routines can be overshadowed by a single final performance.

clips.hook: Does a finalist merely fit in, or do they genuinely elevate the entire cast?
clips.text: The speaker analyzes whether a particular candidate brings true added value to the professional cast or simply meets the minimum requirements to belong.

beschreibung:
Danielle and Val have survived the challenges and made it to the grand finale of the inaugural season of Dancing with the Stars: The Next Pro! Are they happy with the results????

Our celebrity professional dancer (Danielle) and celebrity podcaster (Val) break down the grueling 3-day prep time for the finalists, which should’ve held some weight when evaluating the results. And Val lets us in on a backstage secret about how the DWTS contestants unknowingly control the entire season before even stepping foot in the ballroom.

Plus, Selena and Adam’s jive feels like a croissant without its chocolate, and Danielle and Val might be too hungry to host, on a finale episode of Stepping on Toes!
